english.legislation: Contrary to sections 20(4) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having brought an article / vehicle / animal for weighing / measuring
by means of equipment which was available for use by the public
in accordance with s. 20(1) Weights and Measures Act 1985
on being required by the person attending to the weighing / measuring

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
